summary: strftime parameters: required format string, second (epoch seconds, default now), and utc (2.14+) to format in UTC instead of local time.
questions: How do I format a specific epoch timestamp?
How do I make strftime output UTC?
Which time does strftime use if I don't pass one?

answer_card.title: strftime parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (str, required): strftime format string; some directives aren't supported on all platforms
- `second` (int): epoch seconds to format; defaults to the current time
- `utc` (default false, 2.14+): format in UTC instead of local time
